judge.reason: The plan stays lightweight and inline: it explicitly rejects a swarm ('No swarm: this is small enough for one agent'), defers creating STATUS.md unless asked, keeps policy and compliance out of scope, and invents no deployment history or SLOs. However, it does not give an explicit acceptance check for each slice. Only step 2 (store unit tests) and the final step 6 (build, test, and a manual check) define verification, while steps 3–5 (list/editor UI, search, polish) have no per-slice acceptance criteria.
